title: Scalable Learning from Probability Measures with Mean Measure Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2502.04907v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider statistical learning problems in which data are observed as a set of probability measures. Optimal transport (OT) is a popular tool to compare and manipulate such objects, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when the measures have large support. We study a quantization-based approach in which all input measures are approximated by $K$-point discrete measures sharing a common support. We establish consistency of the resulting quantized measures. We further derive convergence guarantees for several OT-based downstream tasks computed from the quantized measures. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves performance comparable to individual quantization while substantially reducing runtime.

translated_title: 基于均值测度量化的可扩展概率测度学习
translated_abstract: 我们考虑以一组概率测度的形式观测数据的统计学习问题。最优传输（OT）是比较和操作此类对象的常用工具，但当测度具有较大支撑集时，其计算成本变得难以承受。我们研究了一种基于量化的方法，将所有输入测度近似为共享公共支撑集的K点离散测度。我们证明了所得量化测度的一致性，并进一步为基于这些量化测度计算的多个OT相关下游任务推导出收敛性保证。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的数值实验表明，所提出的方法在大幅减少运行时间的同时，实现了与单独量化相当的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种均值测度量化方法，将所有输入概率测度近似为共享公共支撑集的K点离散测度，在保证量化测度一致性和下游任务收敛性的同时，大幅降低最优传输计算的时间成本并保持与单独量化相当的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mean measure quantization approach that approximates all input probability measures by K-point discrete measures sharing a common support, establishing consistency and convergence guarantees for downstream optimal transport tasks while substantially reducing runtime compared to individual quantization.
